#--------------------



library(tidyverse)   # data manipulation + ggplot2
library(lubridate)   # date handling
library(readxl)      # Excel import


# ---- 2. Import data ----
# Skip first row if it contains metadata or merged headers
data_raw <- read_excel(
  path = "AirlineReviews.xlsx",
  skip = 1,
  col_names = TRUE
)


# ---- 3. Keep only variables relevant to airline choice ----
data <- data_raw %>%
  select(
    AirlineName,
    TravelType,
    CabinType,
    DatePub,
    OverallScore,
    ValueRating,
    SeatComfortRating,
    ServiceRating,
    GroundServiceRating,
    FoodRating,
    EntertainmentRating,
    WifiRating
  )


# ---- 4. Clean rating variables ----
# Replace zeros (non-responses) with NA
rating_vars <- c(
  "ValueRating",
  "SeatComfortRating",
  "ServiceRating",
  "GroundServiceRating",
  "FoodRating",
  "EntertainmentRating",
  "WifiRating"
)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rating_vars), ~ na_if(., 0)))


# ---- 5. Focus on non-business (leisure) travel ----
data <- data %>%
  filter(TravelType != "Business")


# ---- 6. Construct airline choice factors ----
# These correspond directly to decision dimensions
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    PriceValue = ValueRating,
    Comfort = SeatComfortRating,

    ServiceQuality = rowMeans(
      select(., ServiceRating, GroundServiceRating),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    OnboardProduct = rowMeans(
      select(., FoodRating, EntertainmentRating, WifiRating),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ---- 7. Parse publication date and extract year ----
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    DatePub_parsed = parse_date_time(
      DatePub,
      orders = c("dmy", "mdy", "ymd", "Ymd", "d b Y")
    ),
    Year = year(DatePub_parsed)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2024)


# ---- 8. Measure average importance of each factor ----
FactorImportance <- data %>%
  summarise(
    PriceValue = mean(PriceValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    Comfort = mean(Comfort, na.rm = TRUE),
    ServiceQuality = mean(ServiceQuality, na.rm = TRUE),
    OnboardProduct = mean(OnboardProduct, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Factor",
    values_to = "AverageRating"
  )


# ---- 9. Visualization: main airline choice factors ----
ggplot(
  FactorImportance,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Factor, AverageRating),
    y = AverageRating,
    fill = Factor
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Main factors influencing airline choice",
    subtitle = "Leisure travelers (1–2024)",
    x = "",
    y = "Average passenger rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )



```

AirlineFactors <- data %>%
  group_by(AirlineName) %>%
  summarise(
    PriceValue = mean(ValueRating, na.rm = TRUE),
    Comfort = mean(SeatComfortRating, na.rm = TRUE),
    Service = mean(ServiceRating, na.rm = TRUE),

  pivot_longer(
    -AirlineName,
    names_to = "Factor",

  )

ggplot(AirlineFactors_long,
       aes(x = reorder(AirlineName, AverageRating),
           y = AverageRating,
           fill = Factor)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +

)

  "Southwest Airlines",

  "Alaska Airlines"
)

  "Japan Airlines",
  "Korean Air",
  "Asiana Airlines",
  "Emirates",
  "Qatar Airways"
)

selected_airlines <- c(
  european_airlines,
  american_airlines,
  asian_airlines
)

  filter(AirlineName %in% selected_airlines)

AirlineFactors <- data_selected %>%
  group_by(AirlineName) %>%
  summarise(
    PriceValue = mean(ValueRating, na.rm = TRUE),
    Comfort = mean(SeatComfortRating, na.rm = TRUE),
    Service = mean(ServiceRating, na.rm = TRUE),

      rowMeans(
        select(cur_data(), FoodRating, EntertainmentRating, WifiRating),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  pivot_longer(
    -AirlineName,
    names_to = "Factor",
    values_to = "AverageRating"
  )

    title = "Perceived value for money by airline",

    y = "Average rating"

  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),

  "Ryanair",
  "Aer Lingus",
  "Emirates",
  "Qatar Airways",
  "Etihad Airways"
)

  group_by(AirlineName, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    PriceValue = mean(ValueRating, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 1995)


AirlineTime <- AirlineTime %>%
